text:
morgan_sales: Hi team — procurement at GreenHaven needs clarification on how our order form maps to their PO. They want: separate invoice per legal entity, PO number on every invoice line, and the MSA signed before first invoice. Is there a standard signing path for multi-entity buys?
neha_legal: @morgan_sales we can do the MSA-first flow. Need to confirm signer order and who countersigns (legal vs finance). Also check the DPA attachment they included — there are two HSM/KMS clauses they want inserted.
pav_cs: Heads-up: this is a Dedicated capacity POC that will convert to Dedicated Reserved. Procurement also asked about SLA language — they want 99.95 uptime in the order form, but sales only committed to 99.9 in commercial terms.
luis_ops: For multi-entity invoices we typically split by billing_entity_id and attach separate DocuSign envelopes. That said, DocuSign doesn't handle two envelopes for the same MSA cleanly — we usually do a single envelope with multiple signers but separate billing metadata.
ron_finance: Procurement insists on net45 for the pilot, but our credit policy is net30 + deposit. Can we offer a one-time net45 for pilot, invoice upfront for the Reserved capacity? Need CFO thumbs up.
morgan_sales: @ron_finance can you escalate? Customer is pushing PO binding on day 0. They want the order form to reference specific SKUs and usage tiers and include a PO clause that locks pricing for 12 months.
neha_legal: I'm attaching the suggested redline snippet to accept HSM language but preserve our liability carveouts. Use this as the canonical clause: 
```
KMS/HSM: Customer-managed key integration permitted subject to audit scope limitations. Redwood retains responsibility for runtime availability; Customer retains key control.
```
If procurement insists on additional indemnity we need sign-off from legal counsel.
pav_cs: Also FYI they want POC credit reconciliation on the order form (line item: POC credit -$X). That needs to be explicit so billing doesn't auto-charge.
luis_ops: Implementation note: to support separate invoices + PO on each line, we'll add `billing_entity_id` and `po_number` fields to the order payload. Example: 
```json
{"order_form": {"lines": [{"sku":"dedicated-gpu-month","qty":1,"billing_entity_id":"GH-US","po_number":"PO-12345"}]}}
```
Should be fine but requires a small billing API change; ops estimate: 2 business days.
ron_finance: If legal approves net45 pilot, finance needs a signed orderform with deposit schedule. Can we put 50% due at countersign and 50% on first invoice?
morgan_sales: Customer accepted 50/50 earlier in the call. I'll confirm and update the order form.
neha_legal: TL;DR from legal: we can accept the HSM insert with tweaks, net45 for pilot acceptable with deposit, SLA stays at 99.9 unless we add a dedicated SRE commitment (adds cost). Also we need a signer mapping table showing: Customer Exec -> MSA, Customer Procurement -> Order Form, Customer Finance -> PO.
pav_cs: Can someone draft the signer mapping table? Procurement asked for an automated routing plan they can verify.
luis_ops: Drafting now. Proposed routing: 
- Envelope A (MSA): Customer Exec (sign), Redwood Legal (sign), Redwood Finance (sign)
- Envelope B (Order Form & PO): Customer Procurement (sign), Customer Finance (sign), Redwood Sales (ack)
Note: Envelope B will reference Envelope A by MSA ID.
morgan_sales: That plan should satisfy their audit team. Please make the envelopes clear in the DocuSign subject lines.
neha_legal: One more: procurement added a clause requiring subprocessor list attachment. We should attach our SOC2 scope and current subprocessor PDF. @pav_cs can you attach?
pav_cs: Adding SOC2 and subprocessor list to the envelope. Also will include a short cover note: "Subprocessors and audit scope attached per procurement request".
ron_finance: Once legal confirms amendment language I'm good to approve net45 pilot + deposit.
morgan_sales: Great — action items: 1) @neha_legal finalize redline (due EOD), 2) @luis_ops add billing_entity_id + po_number API change and draft DocuSign envelope plan (ETA 2 business days), 3) @ron_finance confirm deposit schedule, 4) @pav_cs attach SOC2/subprocessors and push envelopes.
deploy-bot: docuSign envelope created (env_0f3a). morgan_sales: please review.
morgan_sales: Reviewing now, will update thread with final order form before sending. :thumbsup:
